title: Other loads.
officialText:
Where a structure is located in a V zone or Coastal A zone and F is to be considered in design, in
a
addition to the load combinations of Equations 16-1 through 16-7, the structure and portions thereof shall resist the most
critical effects of the load combinations of Equations 16-8 and 16-10. Where a structure is located in an A zone and F is to be
a
considered in design, in addition to the load combinations of Equations 16-1 through 16-7, structures and portions thereof shall
resist the most critical effects of the load combinations of Equations 16-9 and 16-11. Where ice loads are to be considered in
design, the load combinations of Section 2.3.4 of ASCE 7 shall be used. Refer to the following sections for other load
combinations:
Flood Load Combinations:
1.2D + 1.6W + 2.0F + f L + 0.5(L or S or R) (Equation 16-8)
